issues.detail: The Greek text 'δοτω αυτη αποστασιον' (give her a certificate of divorce) is translated as 'hãy cho vợ tờ ly dị' (let him give his wife a divorce paper). While the action is similar, the Vietnamese translation omits the specific object/result of the Greek 'αποστασιον' (a formal certificate/document of divorce) by rendering it as a general command to 'give the divorce', losing the nuance of providing a physical/legal document.
